evidence.claim: Discord collects information you provide, information collected automatically, and information received from other sources.
Discord says processing can include automated technologies such as machine learning systems that help power and improve its services.
Discord says it uses certain information to help deliver its advertising, measure the effectiveness of ads for its own products, and improve them.
Discord says it may provide information to analytics and measurement partners to measure the effectiveness of sponsored content.
Discord states it does not sell personal information.
Discord says it may disclose information in response to legal requests, including law enforcement or national security requirements, if it believes disclosure is required by law.
Discord offers settings to tailor your experience and other privacy-related settings in User Settings.
Deleting an account permanently deletes identifying information and anonymizes other data as described in Discord's retention policy.

Discord says it does not sell personal information but uses information for its own advertising and shares some with analytics and measurement partners; account deletion removes identifying information and anonymizes other data.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 346.13 (report dated Sept. 22, 2026) found code signatures for 3 known tracker SDK(s): AppsFlyer (analytics), Google Analytics (analytics), Sentry (crash reporting). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.

privacyDetails.advertising: Discord says it uses certain information to help deliver its advertising, measure the effectiveness of ads for its own products, and improve them. Third-party finding (Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 346.13): no advertising SDK signatures were detected; absence of a signature does not prove none is used.
privacyDetails.analytics: Discord says it may provide information to analytics and measurement partners to measure the effectiveness of sponsored content. Third-party finding (Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 346.13): code signatures for analytics, crash-reporting or profiling SDKs were detected: AppsFlyer, Google Analytics, Sentry. This shows an SDK is present in the app, not what data it sends.
